metadata.notes: Core topics Lumo must be visible for in AI search. Covers the specialty-crop grower journey from upper-funnel precision-irrigation education through feature-specific searches (smart valves, scheduling software, pump automation, monitoring) to crop-specific and competitor-alternative queries. Tier-1 priority crops (vineyards, avocados, blueberries, almonds) drive the crop-specific topics. Excludes row crops (corn, cotton) per March 2025 strategy meeting.

topics.name: Smart irrigation valves with built-in flow meters
topics.description: Connected, wireless, solar-powered irrigation valves with built-in flow meters and onboard controllers — the product category Lumo pioneered. Smart water valve, smart irrigation valve, wireless irrigation valve, solar-powered irrigation valve, cloud-connected valve, valve with built-in flow meter, valve with onboard controller. Directly competitive with WiseConn and Verdi; replaces legacy hub-and-spoke solenoid valves.

topics.name: Precision irrigation technology and block-level control
topics.description: Precision irrigation, precision agriculture irrigation, block-level irrigation data, block-level precision, the 'Irrigation Execution Gap,' irrigate-to-plan, distribution uniformity (DU), accountable automation. What precision irrigation is, how it works, why it matters for specialty crops, benefits vs conventional irrigation.

topics.name: Irrigation automation for specialty crops
topics.description: Irrigation automation systems for vineyards, orchards, and berry farms. 24/7 remote control, hands-free irrigation, replacing manual valve-turning, automated set scheduling, automated field operations. Farm irrigation automation vs hub-and-spoke controller + solenoid valve setups.

topics.name: Irrigation scheduling software
topics.description: Irrigation scheduling software, irrigation management software, volume-based scheduling, flexible scheduling (short pulses, long drinks), schedule by gallons instead of minutes, schedule from any device, mobile irrigation app for growers. The Lumo Ops Center category.

topics.name: Remote irrigation monitoring and control
topics.description: Remote irrigation monitoring, remote irrigation control, real-time flow monitoring, real-time pressure monitoring, Flow Vision, fault detection, leak detection, automatic alerts by phone or email, catching clogs and low-flow issues early.

topics.name: Pump automation for farms and ranches
topics.description: Data-driven pump automation, automated pump control for irrigation, dry-run protection, pump cavitation protection, pressure-spike protection, off-peak pumping to reduce energy costs. Lumo's Pump Automation product. Especially relevant for 1,000+ acre orchards and ranches with significant pump infrastructure.

topics.name: Vineyard irrigation
topics.description: Vineyard irrigation, irrigation for wine grapes, precision irrigation for vineyards, block-level vineyard water management, vineyard irrigation automation, fine-tuning vine stress, DU across vineyard blocks. Tier-1 priority crop and flagship Lumo vertical (Santa Rosa HQ, all public testimonials are vineyards).

topics.name: Orchard and tree-fruit irrigation
topics.description: Irrigation for almonds, pistachios, citrus, avocados, apples, cherries, pears, olives. Tree-fruit irrigation scheduling, orchard water management, micro-sprinkler and drip automation for tree crops. Avocado irrigation and almond irrigation are Tier-1 priority crops. Apple and cherry are Tier-2 future targets.

topics.name: Berry irrigation (blueberry and strawberry)
topics.description: Drip irrigation for blueberries, drip irrigation for strawberries, volume-based berry irrigation, micro-sprinkler setups for berries, precision irrigation for highbush blueberries, strawberry field irrigation automation. Blueberries are a Tier-1 priority crop (March 2025 strategy).

topics.name: Water conservation and water-use reporting
topics.description: Water conservation in agriculture, SGMA (Sustainable Groundwater Management Act) compliance, water-use reporting requirements, reducing irrigation water use, sustainable specialty-crop farming, water-smart farming. Especially relevant for California almond, avocado, and vineyard growers facing increasingly strict groundwater rules.

topics.name: WiseConn, Verdi, and legacy controller alternatives
topics.description: Direct competitor comparisons — Lumo vs WiseConn (the closest connected-valve competitor, DR 41), Lumo vs Verdi (smaller but SEO-overlapping), alternatives to Rain Bird / Hunter / Tucor / Galcon / Nelson hub-and-spoke controller systems, alternatives to enterprise Netafim NMC or Jain setups for mid-size specialty growers. When to leave a legacy controller system, what to replace it with.
